speaker: Doctor

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Bilirubin_Total: 7 mg/dL, Bilirubin_Direct: 0.6 mg/dL, Maternal_Blood_Group: A, Rh-negative, Fetal_Blood_Group: 0, Rh-positive

speaker: Doctor
text:
The blood type incompatibility is ruled out since the mother is Rh-negative and the baby is Rh-positive, and the bilirubin levels are within the expected range for day two of life. This presentation is consistent with normal physiological jaundice, so no further intervention is currently required.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Physiological Jaundice
